name: Software development
summary: Custom platforms, internal tools and mobile apps built around how your business actually runs.
note: Custom software replaces the spreadsheets and manual steps between your internal tools, mobile teams and finance.

name: Web development
summary: Fast, accessible websites, customer portals and web apps your team can update without a developer.
note: Web development covers the public face of your business and the hosting that keeps it fast.

name: Integrations
summary: Connect payments, CRM, accounting and logistics so data moves once, correctly, without retyping.
note: Integrations link the tools you already pay for, so a sale in your CRM shows up in accounting and reporting on its own.

name: Cloud solutions
summary: Migrate off ageing servers, cut hosting costs and ship new releases without holding your breath.
note: Cloud work sits underneath everything: hosting, storage, backups and how new versions reach production.

name: More services
summary: Product design, data and reporting, IT strategy and audits, and long-term support for live systems.
note: Design and data work makes the rest usable: interfaces your staff like, and dashboards managers actually open.
